plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Exit all remaining leveraged/weak tech names (METU, MUU, MSFU, PLTU).

conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, leading to lower potential drawdowns but also capping upside potential.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to maintain minimal exposure.
Reduce positions in leveraged/weak tech names (METU, MUU, MSFU, PLTU).
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.

This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding diversification. It aims for risk-first growth, accepting moderate drawdowns for potential upside.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and leveraged tech (METU, MUU, MSFU, PLTU).

aggressive.read: This aggressive strategy targets around 4% monthly return by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-conviction names and leveraged ETFs. It accepts substantially higher potential drawdowns and the risks of leveraged ETF decay, requiring strict stop discipline.
